description:
Read a saved property's data with the source beside every value: which provider supplied it, when, how it was selected, whether it is a fallback or a calculation, and which fields are still unknown. Free, makes no paid lookups.

Always tell the user the source of any number you repeat (e.g. "Estimated value $505,000 from RealEstateAPI, retrieved Nov 3"). Calculated values such as estimated equity are Spur's calculation from the listed inputs, never one provider's figure. Unknown means Spur has no value; never present it as zero.

data_points.description: Limit to these data points; omit for everything

items.description: Data point key, e.g. physical.bedrooms or financial.estimated_equity. Call spur_list_data_providers to see keys.

reveal_contacts.description: Explicitly reveal restricted contact values; backend permissions and reveal audit apply

name: spur_get_property_sources
title: Get property data with sources
